market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from 20-year high Treasury yields and oil volatility above $103. Consumer sentiment decline and 2-year high mortgage rates cap upside. However, US-China trade truce extension and Hormuz reopening hopes provide intermittent relief. Expect choppy, range-bound equities with sector rotation favoring energy, defense, and value over growth. Bond volatility will remain elevated.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structurally supportive but bubble risk is real (Meta's $85B loss, 'AI boom ends badly' warning). Rising rates will compress multiples over 6-12 months, favoring earnings-driven names. US-China truce provides 2-month window but structural tensions persist. Housing market remains constrained. Defense spending elevated by Iran conflict. ETF dominance and passive investing trend continues reshaping market structure.
